heading: Housing for All.
text: As a member of the Orange County Affordable Housing Advisory Board, Mike has advocated for an increase in the number of affordable housing units in Orange County. In this role, he, along with a board of volunteers, advocates for the creation of initiatives, policies, and county ordinances that create more affordable housing opportunities for all.
